transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Reported by WSJ: A new artificial intelligence czar has unveiled goals and members of a White House task force.
Reported by Yahoo: OpenAI President Greg Brockman pulled a planned second 25 million dollar donation to an artificial intelligence super PAC, saying he felt terrible.
Still open, per Yahoo Finance: ChatGPT assigns XRP a 1.35 dollar fair value, with future price scenarios tied to Swift or Ripple dominance.
Reported by Crypto Briefing: The US Super Intelligence Force gets 120 days to report on artificial intelligence risks.
Reported by FourWeekMBA: Google limits free Gemini app to Flash-Lite from October 9.
Free every hour.
